'''Ifron''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Thuris sector/Legends|Thuris sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] visited the seedy [[Bovris Tapcafe/Legends|Bovris Tapcafe]] on Ifron during her search for [[Dequc]].
